fusions.name: Barbed Gaff
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. A hooked horn strike that deals 9 damage and makes the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Dragline
fusions.desc: Draws a 6-tile line of rope for 6 seconds, dragging every enemy near it inward, and deals 12 damage to each. Anything struck is stunned for 1 second.

fusions.name: Lariat Pull
fusions.desc: A challenge that pulls up to 4 enemies within 8 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Snagged on the Hurt
fusions.desc: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, a hook snags the nearest enemy within 5 tiles, dealing 5 damage. Once every 6 seconds.
